$comment: Lip sync v1 thresholds for lib/lipsync-volume.mjs. Chosen values, not measurements (author's prompt #14). Loudness is the RMS of one frame's samples, linear, full scale 1.
howChosen: Chosen after looking at the RMS of every frame (30 fps) of P1, P2 and P3 with the provisional voice (npm run lipsync:stats, out/lipsync-stats.txt): 66 of 219 frames are under 0.005 and 10 more under 0.01 (silence and breath); speech sits from about 0.02 up; 46 frames are at 0.08 or above (the loud vowels). restBelow 0.01 (about -40 dBFS) puts silence at rest; openFrom 0.08 (about -22 dBFS) opens the mouth only on the loudest fifth. To be chosen again once the author has picked the voice.
